queries: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT corpeventprx AS event_type, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analyst_reports, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_ownership_difference FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_difference) AS overall_avg_difference FROM event_averages) SELECT e.event_type, e.avg_analyst_reports, e.avg_ownership_difference, e.avg_ownership_difference - o.overall_avg_difference AS difference_from_overall FROM event_averages AS e CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg_difference IS NOT NULL
